WITH BaseCelulas AS ( SELECT CASE WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659685 AND 659690 THEN 'CÉLULA 06' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659691 AND 659696 THEN 'CÉLULA 07' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659697 AND 659702 THEN 'CÉLULA 08' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659703 AND 659708 THEN 'CÉLULA 09' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659709 AND 659714 THEN 'CÉLULA 10' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659715 AND 659720 THEN 'CÉLULA 11' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659721 AND 659726 THEN 'CÉLULA 12' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659727 AND 659732 THEN 'CÉLULA 13' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659733 AND 659738 THEN 'CÉLULA 14' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659739 AND 659744 THEN 'CÉLULA 15' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659745 AND 659750 THEN 'CÉLULA 16' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659751 AND 659756 THEN 'CÉLULA 17' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659757 AND 659762 THEN 'CÉLULA 18' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659763 AND 659768 THEN 'CÉLULA 19' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659769 AND 659774 THEN 'CÉLULA 20' END AS CELULAS, SUM(pk.MAX_UOM_QTY) AS CAPACIDADE_TOTAL FROM LOCN_HDR lh LEFT JOIN PKT_CONSOL_LOCN pk ON lh.LOCN_ID = pk.LOCN_ID WHERE (CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659685 AND 659774) AND PKT_CONSOL_FLAG = '1' and REC_TYPE = 'P' GROUP BY CASE WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659685 AND 659690 THEN 'CÉLULA 06' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659691 AND 659696 THEN 'CÉLULA 07' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659697 AND 659702 THEN 'CÉLULA 08' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659703 AND 659708 THEN 'CÉLULA 09' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659709 AND 659714 THEN 'CÉLULA 10' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659715 AND 659720 THEN 'CÉLULA 11' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659721 AND 659726 THEN 'CÉLULA 12' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659727 AND 659732 THEN 'CÉLULA 13' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659733 AND 659738 THEN 'CÉLULA 14' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659739 AND 659744 THEN 'CÉLULA 15' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659745 AND 659750 THEN 'CÉLULA 16' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659751 AND 659756 THEN 'CÉLULA 17' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659757 AND 659762 THEN 'CÉLULA 18' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659763 AND 659768 THEN 'CÉLULA 19' WHEN CAST(lh.LOCN_ID AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659769 AND 659774 THEN 'CÉLULA 20' END ), BaseTarefas AS ( -- VOLTEI ESTA CTE PARA O SEU ESTADO ORIGINAL RÁPIDO SELECT hr.TASK_DESC, hr.INVN_NEED_TYPE, hr.TASK_ID, ol.TC_SHIPMENT_ID, tl.CARTON_NBR, tl.QTY_ALLOC, tl.QTY_PULLD, tl.ALLOC_UOM_QTY, tl.ALLOC_UOM, IC.BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID, IQ.Std_PACK_QTY, hr.STAT_CODE, ol.LPN_STATUS, TRIM(COALESCE(ol.CURR_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.PREV_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.DEST_SUB_LOCN_ID)) AS CELULA_ID_TAREFA FROM task_hdr hr JOIN task_dtl tl ON hr.TASK_ID = tl.TASK_ID JOIN LPN ol ON TRIM(tl.CARTON_NBR) = TRIM(ol.TC_LPN_ID) JOIN ITEM_CBO IC ON tl.ITEM_ID = IC.ITEM_ID JOIN ITEM_QUANTITY IQ ON IC.ITEM_ID = IQ.ITEM_ID WHERE hr.INVN_NEED_TYPE IN ('50','2') AND CAST(ol.LPN_FACILITY_STATUS AS NUMBER) < 90 AND ol.LPN_STATUS NOT IN ('35','99') ), TarefasMapeadas AS ( SELECT bt.*, CASE WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659685 AND 659690 THEN 'CÉLULA 06' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659691 AND 659696 THEN 'CÉLULA 07' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659697 AND 659702 THEN 'CÉLULA 08' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659703 AND 659708 THEN 'CÉLULA 09' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659709 AND 659714 THEN 'CÉLULA 10' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659715 AND 659720 THEN 'CÉLULA 11' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659721 AND 659726 THEN 'CÉLULA 12' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659727 AND 659732 THEN 'CÉLULA 13' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659733 AND 659738 THEN 'CÉLULA 14' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659739 AND 659744 THEN 'CÉLULA 15' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659745 AND 659750 THEN 'CÉLULA 16' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659751 AND 659756 THEN 'CÉLULA 17' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659757 AND 659762 THEN 'CÉLULA 18' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659763 AND 659768 THEN 'CÉLULA 19' WHEN CAST(CELULA_ID_TAREFA AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659769 AND 659774 THEN 'CÉLULA 20' ELSE 'OUTRAS' END AS CELULAS FROM BaseTarefas bt WHERE CELULA_ID_TAREFA IS NOT NULL ), StatusTarefas AS ( SELECT COALESCE(MAX(CASE WHEN INVN_NEED_TYPE = '50' THEN TASK_DESC END) OVER (PARTITION BY CELULAS), TASK_DESC) AS TASK_DESC_AGRUPADO, CELULAS, TC_SHIPMENT_ID, CARTON_NBR, TASK_ID, QTY_ALLOC, QTY_PULLD, ALLOC_UOM_QTY, ALLOC_UOM, BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID, Std_PACK_QTY, MIN(CASE WHEN STAT_CODE='5' THEN 1 WHEN STAT_CODE='10' THEN 2 WHEN STAT_CODE='13' THEN 3 WHEN STAT_CODE='15' THEN 4 WHEN STAT_CODE='20' THEN 5 WHEN STAT_CODE='30' THEN 6 WHEN STAT_CODE='40' THEN 7 WHEN STAT_CODE='90' THEN 99 ELSE 50 END) OVER (PARTITION BY CARTON_NBR) AS RANK_STATUS_CAIXA, MIN(CASE WHEN STAT_CODE='5' THEN 1 WHEN STAT_CODE='10' THEN 2 WHEN STAT_CODE='13' THEN 3 WHEN STAT_CODE='15' THEN 4 WHEN STAT_CODE='20' THEN 5 WHEN STAT_CODE='30' THEN 6 WHEN STAT_CODE='40' THEN 7 WHEN STAT_CODE='90' THEN 99 ELSE 50 END) OVER (PARTITION BY TC_SHIPMENT_ID) AS RANK_STATUS_EMBARQUE, MAX(CASE WHEN LPN_STATUS='30' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) OVER (PARTITION BY TC_SHIPMENT_ID) AS EMB_VAI_CARREGAR FROM TarefasMapeadas WHERE CELULAS <> 'OUTRAS' ), ResumoTarefas AS ( SELECT TASK_DESC_AGRUPADO AS TASK_DESC, CELULAS, COUNT(DISTINCT CARTON_NBR) - COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EMB_VAI_CARREGAR = 1 THEN CARTON_NBR END) AS TOTAL_DE_OLPN, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA = 99 THEN CARTON_NBR END) AS OLPNS_COMPLETAS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA IN (1, 2, 3) THEN CARTON_NBR END) AS OLPNS_AG_SEPARACAO, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA > 3 AND RANK_STATUS_CAIXA < 99 THEN CARTON_NBR END) AS OLPNS_EM_ANDAMENTO,
COUNT(DISTINCT TC_SHIPMENT_ID) AS TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_EMBARQUE = 99 THEN TC_SHIPMENT_ID END) AS EMBARQUES_COMPLETOS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_EMBARQUE < 99 THEN TC_SHIPMENT_ID END) AS EMBARQUES_EM_ANDAMENTO, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN EMB_VAI_CARREGAR = 1 THEN CARTON_NBR END) AS OLPNS_A_CARREGAR,
SUM(CASE WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) AS TOTAL_QTD,
SUM(CASE WHEN BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID = 233 THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) WHEN ALLOC_UOM IN ('B') AND QTY_PULLD >= 100 AND ALLOC_UOM_QTY = 1 THEN 0 WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) AS SEPARADO,
SUM(CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA > 3 AND RANK_STATUS_CAIXA < 99 THEN (CASE WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) - (CASE WHEN BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID = 233 THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) WHEN ALLOC_UOM IN ('B') AND QTY_PULLD >= 100 AND ALLOC_UOM_QTY = 1 THEN 0 WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) ELSE 0 END) AS PENDENTE,
SUM(CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA IN (1, 2, 3) THEN (CASE WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_ALLOC / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) - (CASE WHEN BASE_STORAGE_UOM_ID = 233 THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) WHEN ALLOC_UOM IN ('B') AND QTY_PULLD >= 100 AND ALLOC_UOM_QTY = 1 THEN 0 WHEN ALLOC_UOM = 'U' THEN QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(ALLOC_UOM_QTY, 0) ELSE QTY_PULLD / NULLIF(Std_PACK_QTY, 0) END) ELSE 0 END) AS CX_AG_SEPARACAO,
COUNT(DISTINCT TASK_ID) AS TOTAL_TAREFAS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA = 99 THEN TASK_ID END) AS TAREFAS_COMPLETAS, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA IN (1, 2, 3) THEN TASK_ID END) AS TAREFAS_AG_SEPARACAO, COUNT(DISTINCT CASE WHEN RANK_STATUS_CAIXA > 3 AND RANK_STATUS_CAIXA < 99 THEN TASK_ID END) AS TAREFAS_EM_ANDAMENTO
FROM StatusTarefas GROUP BY TASK_DESC_AGRUPADO, CELULAS ),

CAST(TRIM(COALESCE(ol.CURR_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.PREV_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.DEST_SUB_LOCN_ID)) AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659763 AND 659768 THEN 'CÉLULA 19' WHEN CAST(TRIM(COALESCE(ol.CURR_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.PREV_SUB_LOCN_ID, ol.DEST_SUB_LOCN_ID)) AS NUMBER) BETWEEN 659769 AND 659774 THEN 'CÉLULA 20' ELSE 'OUTRAS' END AS CELULAS FROM UltimosUsuarios u JOIN LPN ol ON TRIM(u.ULTIMO_CARTON) = TRIM(ol.TC_LPN_ID) ), ColaboradoresPorCelula AS ( -- Agrupa os totais rápidos por célula SELECT CELULAS, COUNT(USER_ID) AS COLAB_ULTIMA_HORA, COUNT(CASE WHEN ULTIMA_DATA >= SYSDATE - 15/(24*60) THEN USER_ID END) AS COLAB_ULTIMOS_15_MIN FROM UsuariosNasCelulas WHERE CELULAS <> 'OUTRAS' GROUP BY CELULAS ) -- >>> FIM DO BLOCO ISOLADO <<<
SELECT COALESCE(t.TASK_DESC, 'Disponível / Sem Tarefas') AS TASK_DESC, c.CELULAS,
COALESCE(cc.COLAB_ULTIMA_HORA, 0) AS COLAB_ULTIMA_HORA, COALESCE(cc.COLAB_ULTIMOS_15_MIN, 0) AS COLAB_ULTIMOS_15_MIN,
COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) AS TOTAL_DE_OLPN, COALESCE(t.OLPNS_COMPLETAS, 0) AS OLPNS_COMPLETAS, COALESCE(t.OLPNS_EM_ANDAMENTO, 0) AS OLPNS_EM_ANDAMENTO, COALESCE(t.OLPNS_AG_SEPARACAO, 0) AS OLPNS_AG_SEPARACAO,
COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES, 0) AS TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES, COALESCE(t.EMBARQUES_COMPLETOS, 0) AS EMBARQUES_COMPLETOS, COALESCE(t.EMBARQUES_EM_ANDAMENTO, 0) AS EMBARQUES_EM_ANDAMENTO, COALESCE(t.OLPNS_A_CARREGAR, 0) AS OLPNS_A_CARREGAR, ROUND(COALESCE(t.TOTAL_QTD, 0)) AS TOTAL_QTD, ROUND(COALESCE(t.SEPARADO, 0)) AS SEPARADO,
ROUND(COALESCE(t.PENDENTE, 0)) AS PENDENTE, ROUND(COALESCE(t.CX_AG_SEPARACAO, 0)) AS CX_AG_SEPARACAO,
COALESCE(t.TOTAL_TAREFAS, 0) AS TOTAL_TAREFAS, COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_COMPLETAS, 0) AS TAREFAS_COMPLETAS, COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_AG_SEPARACAO, 0) AS TAREFAS_AG_SEPARACAO, COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_EM_ANDAMENTO, 0) AS TAREFAS_EM_ANDAMENTO,
COALESCE(c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL, 0) AS CAPACIDADE_TOTAL, (COALESCE(c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL, 0) - COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0)) AS TOTAL_DISPONIVEL,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL, 0) = 0 THEN '🔴 LOTADA' WHEN (COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) * 100 / c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL) <= 70 THEN '🟢 LIVRE' WHEN (COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) * 100 / c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL) <= 90 THEN '🟡 ATENÇÃO' ELSE '🔴 LOTADA' END AS FAROL,
ROUND(COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) * 100 / NULLIF(c.CAPACIDADE_TOTAL, 0), 0) AS PCT_OCUPACAO,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.OLPNS_COMPLETAS,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_PALLETS_COMPLETOS, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.OLPNS_EM_ANDAMENTO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_PALLETS_ANDAMENTO, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.OLPNS_AG_SEPARACAO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_DE_OLPN, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_PALLETS_AG_SEPARACAO,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_QTD,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.SEPARADO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_QTD, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_CX_SEPARADAS, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_QTD,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.PENDENTE,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_QTD, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_CX_PENDENTES, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_QTD,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.CX_AG_SEPARACAO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_QTD, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_CX_AG_SEPARACAO,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.EMBARQUES_COMPLETOS,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_EMB_COMPLETOS, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.EMBARQUES_EM_ANDAMENTO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_DE_EMBARQUES, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_EMB_ANDAMENTO,
CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_TAREFAS,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_COMPLETAS,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_TAREFAS, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_TAREFAS_COMPLETAS, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_TAREFAS,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_EM_ANDAMENTO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_TAREFAS, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_TAREFAS_EM_ANDAMENTO, CASE WHEN COALESCE(t.TOTAL_TAREFAS,0) > 0 THEN ROUND(COALESCE(t.TAREFAS_AG_SEPARACAO,0) * 100 / t.TOTAL_TAREFAS, 0) ELSE 0 END AS BARRA_TAREFAS_AG_SEPARACAO,
CASE c.CELULAS WHEN 'CÉLULA 06' THEN 06 WHEN 'CÉLULA 07' THEN 07 WHEN 'CÉLULA 08' THEN 08 WHEN 'CÉLULA 09' THEN 09 WHEN 'CÉLULA 10' THEN 10 WHEN 'CÉLULA 11' THEN 11 WHEN 'CÉLULA 12' THEN 12 WHEN 'CÉLULA 13' THEN 13 WHEN 'CÉLULA 14' THEN 14 WHEN 'CÉLULA 15' THEN 15 WHEN 'CÉLULA 16' THEN 16 WHEN 'CÉLULA 17' THEN 17 WHEN 'CÉLULA 18' THEN 18 WHEN 'CÉLULA 19' THEN 19 WHEN 'CÉLULA 20' THEN 20 ELSE 999 END AS SORT_KEY FROM BaseCelulas c LEFT JOIN ResumoTarefas t ON c.CELULAS = t.CELULAS LEFT JOIN ColaboradoresPorCelula cc ON c.CELULAS = cc.CELULAS ORDER BY SORT_KEY ASC
